note: Per-URL content hash and the date that content last changed. lastmod only advances for a URL whose hash changed; see scripts/lib/lastmod_ledger.js. Dates were reseeded from real git history by scripts/reseed_lastmod_from_git.js: lastmod is the newest commit date across the committed files that page is rendered from, first_seen the oldest commit that added one of them. A URL whose sources could not be resolved kept its previous entry rather than being given an invented date. Entries are merged, never pruned: dist/ holds one pack at a time.
